items.question: Who is TOPTI for?
items.answer: TOPTI is built for independent English teachers running IELTS, TOEIC and conversation practice classes, along with their students and platform administrators.

items.question: Do students need a paid account?
items.answer: No. Students create a free account and just enter the 6-character class code the teacher gives them.

items.question: Where do the generated assignments come from?
items.answer: The teacher uploads a spreadsheet with Word, IPA, Meaning and Example columns. TOPTI generates the ABCD questions and matching game — no need to prepare distractor answers.

items.question: How does plan payment work?
items.answer: Teachers pick a plan by student-slot count and scan a VietQR code to pay; the account is activated as soon as the transaction succeeds.

cta.title: Ready to leave manual grading behind?
cta.subtitle: Create a free teacher account and have your first class running in under 5 minutes.

pricing.metaDescription: Compare TOPTI plans by student-slot count: Free, Professional and Enterprise.
pricing.title: Simple pricing, by student count
pricing.subtitle: Pick the plan that fits your class size. Upgrade any time as your classes grow.

faq.question: What is a student slot?
faq.answer: A slot is the maximum number of students that can be active at the same time across all of a teacher's classes.

faq.question: Can I upgrade any time?
faq.answer: Yes. You can upgrade from the Billing page and pay the difference via VietQR.

help.metaDescription: How to use TOPTI for teachers and students: create classes, enter a class code, submit work and pay for a plan.
help.title: Help center
help.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions about TOPTI.

teacherTopics.q: How do I create a class?
teacherTopics.a: Open the teacher dashboard, click 'New class' in the sidebar, name the class and get a 6-character code.

teacherTopics.q: What format does the vocabulary spreadsheet need?
teacherTopics.a: The file needs Word, IPA, Meaning and Example columns. The system generates the quiz and matching minigame from that data.

teacherTopics.q: How do I upgrade my plan?
teacherTopics.a: Go to Billing, choose the plan you want and scan the VietQR code to pay. The account is activated as soon as the transaction succeeds.

studentTopics.q: How do I join a class?
studentTopics.a: Create a free account, then enter the 6-character class code your teacher gives you on the dashboard.

studentTopics.q: What happens if time runs out before I finish?
studentTopics.a: The system locks the assignment and sends your current result to the server the moment the time limit is reached.

studentTopics.q: Can I review the correct answers after submitting?
studentTopics.a: Yes. After you submit, the result screen shows a detailed explanation for every question.
